obligations.statement: Option 1 with answer text "Alpha option" is displayed on Q1.
Option 2 with answer text "Beta option" is displayed on Q1.
Option 3 with answer text "Gamma option" is displayed as the final option on Q1.

obligations.doc_quote: Q1 | Code 2 selected (Beta) | Continue to Q3
obligations.statement: If a respondent selects "Beta" for Q1, the next screen must be Q3.

obligations.doc_quote: Q1 | Any code other than code 1 | Continue to Q3
obligations.statement: If a respondent does not select code 1 at Q1, the next screen must be Q3.

obligations.doc_quote: Q3 | Any code other than code 1 | Continue to D1
obligations.statement: If a respondent does not select code 1 at Q3, the next screen must be D1.

obligations.doc_quote: ASK ONLY THOSE WHO ANSWERED CODE 1 AT Q1.
obligations.statement: Q2 must be displayed only to respondents who selected answer code 1 on Q1.
Q4 requires the respondent to select at least one answer before proceeding.
Q6 requires the respondent to select at least one answer before proceeding.
Q7 requires the respondent to select at least one answer before proceeding.

obligations.doc_quote: NO BACK BUTTON ON THE WELCOME SCREEN.
obligations.statement: The welcome screen must not display a back button.

ambiguities.doc_quote: SHOW A BACK BUTTON ON EVERY SCREEN EXCEPT THE WELCOME SCREEN AND THE TWO CLOSING SCREENS.
ambiguities.reading_a: The two closing screens are the final thank-you screen and the screen-out screen.
ambiguities.reading_b: The two closing screens are the penultimate debrief screen and the final completion screen.
ambiguities.why_ambiguous: The document never says which screens are the closing ones.

ambiguities.doc_quote: Q1 | Code 2 selected (Beta) | Continue to Q3
ambiguities.reading_b: Code 2 continues to Q2 and only then to Q3.
ambiguities.why_ambiguous: The routing table and the prose disagree about the destination for code 2.
